_comment: Rules text for the six Tactics Cards, transcribed from the English card scans in assets/cards/en/. The community card database carries their names and point cost but no text, so this fills the gap. Merged at load time as a synthetic action on each card, which is why every tactic shows up with the Tactic action icon.
_note: Card 274 prints as 'Additional Instructions'; the card database calls it 'Additional Command'. The printed name is used. Card 278 prints 'Tactical Disposition'; the database misspells it 'Dispostion'.
_cost: All six cost 30 points, taken from the community card database; the printed card leaves the points area blank because values are maintained online through the QR code. The circled 1 beside the card number is not a points value and not a copy limit: it is identical on every Tactics Card, as is the 88 in the corner, which is the rulebook page where Tactics Cards are explained. It reads as the per-round play limit from 5.4.2.

274.name: Additional Instructions
274.text: Use during the Command Phase, select 1 Ally Drone and have it perform 1 additional Command Action.

275.name: Battlefield Recovery
275.text: Use during the End Phase, select 1 Ally Mech that is not in Shutdown Stance and restore 1 Link Value.

276.name: Hit and Run
276.text: Use when the Action Opportunity of an Ally Mech ends, perform Maneuver with that Mech.

277.name: System Repair
277.text: Use during the Action Opportunity of an Ally Mech, select 1 Ally Unit and remove 1 Square Token or 1 Hexagon Token from that Unit.

278.name: Tactical Disposition
278.text: Use during the Action Opportunity of an Ally Mech, select 1 Ally Mech that is not in Shutdown Stance and change its Stance.

279.name: Remote Restart
279.text: Use during the End Phase, select 1 Ally Mech that is in Shutdown Stance, change its Stance and restore 1 Link Value.

_limit: Each player may only use 1 Tactics Card per round (Rulebook 5.4.2). There is no printed cap on how many you may include in a squad.
